# Mainländer

*1841 – 1876 · German*

German philosopher, author of the Philosophy of Redemption: the universe would be the corpse of a God who willed nothingness, and every thing would tend toward its own extinction. A radical disciple of [Schopenhauer](../philosophers/schopenhauer.md), he took his own life as his book came out.
